text:
Maya Patel: Quick thread — thinking about shrinking the model-binding/rollout metadata we send to clients. current payloads include a lot of fields that only the control plane cares about (audit, human notes, long provenance). proposal: make the canonical binding a tiny on-the-wire shape (canonical_id, fingerprint, affinity_hint, expires_at) and push bulk metadata to a separate fetchable blob that clients only request when needed. thoughts?
Kevin Zhou: +1 on reducing size. biggest win is lower memory & fewer bytes in many customer gateways. agree with split. we should explicitly remove free-text fields from the primary shape. :thumbsup:
Olga Petrov: worried about observability/rollout debugging. if clients don't get provenance, correlating a client-side error to a rollout becomes harder. can we add an opt-in small `debug_hint` (opaque id) that maps to server-side metadata?
Ryan Li: for clients that already have previous binding, we can delta-encode: send `base_ref` + `patch` instead of full shape. small example: ```json
{"base_ref":"c-abc123","patch":{"fingerprint":"f-987","affinity":0.7}}
``` this reduces churn for frequent check-ins.
Sophia Cruz: SDK compatibility note — older sdks will choke if we remove fields. need compatibility header or versioned envelope so server can return legacy shape when requested.
DevOps Bot: New RFC created by @Maya: https://rfc.internal/r/1234 - "Compact-binding-surface" — reviewers requested: @Kevin @Olga @Ryan @Sophia
Kevin Zhou: security note: some metadata has tenant-readable names. if we cache blobs, ensure blobs are tenant-scoped and not exposing other tenant info. prefer `owner_hash` instead of plain tenant id in compact shape.
Maya Patel: good call on owner hashing. my proposed compact primary shape (minimal) = `{
  "canonical_id":"<id>",
  "fingerprint":"<hash>",
  "affinity_hint":<float>,
  "expires_at":<iso>
}` secondary blob = larger provenance + human notes + rollout plan url. default client behavior: only fetch blob on error or when asked by operator.
Olga Petrov: that works if we keep a telemetry hook: when a client fetches blob, emit a trace/span with `binding_fingerprint` so we can stitch requests -> rollout. also add sampling so we don't explode storage.
Ryan Li: I'll run a quick bench on typical SDK check-in payload size and estimate savings. aim is ~30-50% fewer bytes for common check-ins. will post numbers by EOD.
Sophia Cruz: once RFC lands, SDK plan: add `Accept-Binding-Version: compact-v1` header and fallback behavior for older servers. will need ~2 weeks to update runtimes and publish patch.
Maya Patel: next steps: 1) Kevin/Olga security & observability signoff 2) Ryan bench numbers 3) I’ll update RFC with compact schema + sample server shim. please sign off in thread by Thu COB. thanks. :pray:
